name: UnionBytes Realistic Water textures
creator: Achim Menzel (AiYori), UnionBytes and Realistic Water Shader contributors
integration: Original source textures copied unchanged. Vesper shader integrates layered flow, long-wave displacement, reverse-Z contact depth, restrained foam and existing planar reflections. The entire upstream water system and its sample boat are not used. No upscaling or claim of 4K assets.
cost: Free; no subscription or runtime service
